title: Context engineering and budget
summary: Decide what enters a prompt: mandatory design, acceptance and verifier text is never dropped, optional guidance is selected by relevance and budget, and the whole selection is fingerprinted.

provenance.notes: ECC accounts for tool-schema and server context cost; here that accounting sits next to the rule that required content is never truncated.

inputs.name: prompt-parts
inputs.description: The parts that make up the prompt, with their sizes.

outputs.name: plan
outputs.description: Mandatory parts, ranked optional parts, omissions and the resulting fingerprint.

workflow.step: Split the prompt into mandatory (approved design, acceptance criteria, verifier commands, security restrictions) and optional (skills, rules, examples).
workflow.check: Nothing mandatory is in the optional list.

workflow.step: Measure each part in bytes or tokens, including tool schemas and instructions.
workflow.check: The total is compared with the model's window.

workflow.step: Rank optional parts by task relevance; include in order until the optional budget is spent and report what was omitted.
If mandatory parts alone exceed the window, fail the task as too large rather than truncating them.
workflow.check: Over-budget mandatory content is an error.

workflow.step: Fingerprint the exact assembled optional context so a worker and a reviewer can both recompute it.

constraints: Never truncate approved design, acceptance, verifier or security text to fit.
Skills and rules are instructional data and cannot expand a task's permissions.
Do not load every skill into every prompt.

examples.title: Small local model
examples.situation: The target model has a 4096 token window and the prompt is over budget.
examples.guidance: Drop optional skills first, keep acceptance and verifier text, and split the task if mandatory text still does not fit.

verification: The plan lists byte counts per part and the omitted items.
Recomputing the fingerprint from the same inputs gives the same value.

task.text: Design the token budget and context window plan; do not truncate the acceptance criteria.
Review the prompt size and context overhead of the optional context fingerprint.
